title: Workbenched
description: Workbenched is an WIP schematic mod with a new more modern design.
body:
# Workbenched

**Workbenched** is a Fabric schematic mod for **Minecraft 26.2**, based on [Litematica](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/litematica). Build, place, and verify large structures — now with a brand-new schematic format built for modern workflows.

---

## Features

### All-new `.workbench` schematic format
Workbenched ships **`.workbench`**, a new schematic format designed from the ground up for interactive building:

- Native support for per-block **roles** (Structure, Decoration, and more)
- Built-in **3D Viewer** with role tinting and Y-layer slicing
- Role-aware verifier so you only check what matters
- Save, load, and place like classic schematics — with richer data under the hood

Classic `.litematic` files still work. `.workbench` is the next step.

### Schematics & placements
- Load and place `.litematic` and `.workbench` schematics
- Ghost-block overlay so you can see exactly what to build
- Material lists and easy / easy place helpers
- Area selection, save, and export tools

### Main menu
- **Recent** schematics for quick reopen
- Placement **sidebar** with preview, toggle, unload, and rename
- Quick search by filename, name, author, or size

### Look & feel
- Dark Workbenched UI theme across menus and browsers
- Built for Minecraft 26.2 / Fabric

---

## Requirements

| Dependency | Notes |
|---|---|
| **Minecraft** | 26.2 |
| **Fabric Loader** | Compatible with current 26.2 builds |
| **[MaLiLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/malilib)** | Required (Sakura / 26.2 build) |

> Client-side only. Not needed on a dedicated server.

---

## Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) for Minecraft 26.2  
2. Drop **MaLiLib** and **Workbenched** into your `mods` folder  
3. Launch the game and open the Workbenched menu (default hotkey from MaLiLib / mod config)
